description: This file defines the NotEqualBinary class in Twig, representing the implementation for the != operator in binary expressions within the Twig template engine. It handles compilation of the 'not equal' expression, with version-specific logic for PHP compatibility.

classes.name: Twig\Node\Expression\Binary\NotEqualBinary
classes.description: Represents the 'not equal' binary operation (!=) within Twig's expression nodes, handling compilation based on PHP version.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the 'not equal' binary expression into PHP code, using different strategies depending on PHP version.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the PHP operator string for 'not equal', i.e., '!='.
